articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning and 1M Token Context
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo in late August 2026, featuring a native 1-million-token context window and deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video inputs. Benchmarks show significant gains in long-horizon planning tasks and multi-step code generation, with latency improvements of roughly 40% over the initial GPT-5 release. The model is available via API with tiered pricing that undercuts previous generation costs.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Graduate-Level Science Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which sets new records on GPQA-Diamond and a newly introduced graduate-level multi-domain science benchmark called SciArena. The model demonstrates substantially improved chain-of-thought calibration and can autonomously design and critique experimental protocols in biology and chemistry. Google is integrating it across Workspace, Cloud, and a new research-assistant product aimed at pharmaceutical and materials-science R&D.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoids in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure Robotics confirmed that its third-generation humanoid robot, Figure 03, has entered full commercial deployment at two BMW manufacturing plants in South Carolina. The robots handle bin-picking, parts transfer, and quality-inspection tasks autonomously, guided by a vision-language-action model trained on factory-specific data. BMW reports a 22% throughput increase in pilot lines, marking one of the first large-scale commercial humanoid deployments in automotive manufacturing.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Completion in Public Demo
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid performing extended household routines including laundry folding, dish loading, and table clearing with minimal teleoperation. The robot uses an end-to-end transformer-based motor policy trained largely in simulation with real-world fine-tuning. Elon Musk stated limited external sales would begin in Q1 2027, with an initial price target under $25,000, though analysts remain cautious about timeline feasibility.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers 2.0' to Mitigate Jailbreaks Across Frontier Models
articles.summary: Anthropic published a new paper and open-source toolkit for Constitutional Classifiers 2.0, a defense-in-depth framework that reduced successful jailbreak rates to under 1% on red-team evaluations across Claude and third-party frontier models. The system layers input classifiers, latent-space probes, and output validators, all trained against a continuously updated adversarial corpus. The toolkit is model-agnostic and has already been adopted by several enterprise AI platforms for production safety filtering.

articles.title: ASML Reports Breakthrough in High-NA EUV Yields, Accelerating Sub-2nm Chip Production
articles.summary: ASML disclosed that its high-numerical-aperture EUV lithography systems have achieved production-grade yields exceeding 90% on critical layers for sub-2nm process nodes at partner fabs. This milestone removes a major bottleneck that had slowed the transition from standard EUV, and both TSMC and Intel confirmed accelerated timelines for their 1.4nm and 14A nodes respectively. The development is expected to sustain Moore's Law scaling through the end of the decade.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance to Expand BCI Trial to 50 Patients with Spinal Cord Injuries
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink expanded approval to implant its N2 brain-computer interface in up to 50 patients with cervical spinal cord injuries, following positive 12-month safety and efficacy data from its initial cohort. Patients demonstrated reliable cursor control, text entry, and robotic arm manipulation at speeds approaching 40 words per minute. The expansion makes it the largest intracortical BCI trial to date and includes a new wireless charging system that eliminates percutaneous connectors.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture at 1.2 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth, a 1.2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 128 experts and 16 active per token, under a permissive open-source license. The model matches or exceeds proprietary frontier model performance on major benchmarks while requiring significantly less inference compute than dense models of equivalent capability. The release includes optimized serving code for multi-node deployments and has catalyzed a wave of enterprise self-hosted AI adoption, intensifying the open-vs-closed model debate.
